C1forced.operation: STEER toward the minority (own + 2 x (minority-class mean - default-class mean)) on all five nodes at once

conditions.PREFILL: prompt + opening prefilled for every arm; uniforms offset by the opening length
conditions.FREE: no prefill; OPEN/DEC edits fire only while the generated prefix equals the opening (implemented exactly by teacher-forcing the edited opening and sampling with the slot's uniforms until the first divergence)
